赵志军的脸一下子变了：“三姐夫，他们……他们也卖烧饼夹肉？还比咱们便宜五分钱？”

林国强没说话，站在灶台后面，看着对面的铺子。

那间铺面不大，但位置不错，正对着农机厂大门，跟他的店隔着一条街打擂台。

门口站着一个人，四十来岁，矮胖身材，穿着一件蓝色的工装，正在招呼客人。

那人他认识。

姓钱，叫钱大勇，原来在镇上国营饭店当厨师，后来国营饭店效益不好，听说他辞职了，没想到在这儿开了店。

“三姐夫，你倒是说句话啊！”

赵志军急了，“他们卖两毛五，比咱们便宜五分！这不是明摆着抢生意吗？”

“看见了。”林国强语气平淡，“急什么？”

“我能不急吗？咱们的客人都被他们拉走了……”

林国强没理他，转身去灶台后面收拾东西。

他看起来很平静，甚至有点不紧不慢的。

赵志军急得直跺脚，跑到门口去看。

果然，几个老顾客本来往国强小吃走的，看见对面开了新店，又便宜五分钱，犹豫了一下，拐进了王家小吃。

“三姐夫，老周也过去了！”

赵志军的声音都变了调。

“看见了。”林国强头也没抬。

“你……你就这么看着？”

林国强把抹布拧干，挂在灶台上，走到门口，靠在门框上，看着对面。

王家小吃门口排了几个人的队，钱大勇站在灶台后面，动作倒是麻利。

但林国强看了一会儿就看出了门道。

他烙饼的手法不对，火候掌握不好，有几张饼边缘都糊了。

卤肉的颜色太深，酱油放多了，看着发黑，不像他的是红亮红亮的。

“志军，你过来。”

赵志军跑过来：“咋了？”

“你看他烙饼。”

赵志军看了一会儿，皱起了眉头：“他那个饼……好像没烙透？”

“对，火太大了，外面焦了，里面可能还不熟。”林国强指着钱大勇的灶台，“再看他的卤肉。”

“颜色太深了。”

“嗯，酱油放多了，说明他卤汤的底子不行，靠酱油上色。”

林国强收回目光，“咱们的卤汤是老汤，越熬越香，他那个，赶不上。”

赵志军听着，慢慢不急了，但还是有些不甘心：“可是他们便宜五分钱啊。

Zhao Zhijun's face suddenly changed: "Third brother-in-law, they... they also sell sesame cakes with meat? Are they five cents cheaper than us?"

Lin Guoqiang said nothing, standing behind the stove and looking at the shop opposite.

The shop was not big, but it was in a good location, facing the gate of the agricultural machinery factory and across the street from his shop.

There was a man standing at the door, about forty years old, short and fat, wearing a blue overalls, greeting guests.

He knew that person.

My surname is Qian, my name is Qian Dayong. He used to work as a chef in a state-owned hotel in the town. Later, the state-owned hotel's performance was not good. I heard that he resigned, but I didn't expect to open a store here.

"Third brother-in-law, please say something!"

Zhao Zhijun was anxious, "They sell it for 25 cents, which is five cents cheaper than us! Isn't this an obvious grab for business?"

"I saw it." Lin Guoqiang said calmly, "Why are you so anxious?"

"Can I not be in a hurry? All our guests have been taken away by them..."

Lin Guoqiang ignored him and turned around to pack things behind the stove.

He seemed calm, even a little unhurried.

Zhao Zhijun was so anxious that he stamped his feet and ran to the door to take a look.

Sure enough, a few old customers who were going to Guoqiang Snacks saw a new store opened opposite and it was five cents cheaper. They hesitated and turned into Wang's Snacks.

"Third brother-in-law, Lao Zhou has also passed by!"

Zhao Zhijun's voice changed its tone.

"I saw it." Lin Guoqiang didn't even raise his head.

"You...you just look at it like this?"

Lin Guoqiang wrung out the rag, hung it on the stove, walked to the door, leaned against the door frame, and looked across.

There were several people lined up at the entrance of Wangjia Snacks. Qian Dayong stood behind the stove, his movements were deft.

But Lin Guoqiang saw the clue after looking at it for a while.

His pancake technique was wrong, he didn't control the heat well, and some of the pancakes were burnt at the edges.

The color of the braised pork was too dark, and too much soy sauce was added. It looked black, unlike his which was bright red.

"Zhijun, come here."

Zhao Zhijun ran over: "What's wrong?"

"Look at him pancakes."

Zhao Zhijun looked at it for a while and frowned: "His cake... doesn't seem to be baked through?"

"Yes, the fire is too strong. The outside is burnt, but the inside may not be cooked yet." Lin Guoqiang pointed to Qian Dayong's stove, "Look at his braised pork."

"The color is too dark."

"Well, adding too much soy sauce means that his soup base is not good and he relies on soy sauce for color."

Lin Guoqiang withdrew his gaze and said, "Our stewed soup is old. The longer it is cooked, the more fragrant it becomes. His soup cannot keep up."

Zhao Zhijun listened and gradually became less anxious, but still a little unwilling: "But they are five cents cheaper.
